blocks.text: Genetically modified organism (GMO) aisa paudha, janwar ya jaraseem hai jis ka genome badla gaya ho. Transgenic jandar GMOs ka khaas group hain jinhein kisi mukhtalif, ghair mutaliq species ka DNA mila ho.

Kitab kehti hai ke duniya mein ugne wali canola, kapaas, makai, soybean aur chukandar ka taqreeban 90% transgenic hai. Itni zyada shareh kuch mulkon, jaise United States, ke liye batayi jati hai; aalami satah par in mein se kai faslon ki shareh kam hai.

blocks.explanation: Nahi. Badle hue genome wala har jandar GMO hai; transgenic sirf tab hai jab use kisi mukhtalif, ghair mutaliq species ka DNA mila ho.

items: GMO: genome badla hua; transgenic: doosri species ka DNA rakhta hai.
